newsitem.title: USA: Liposome says investor buys 1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Liposome says investor buys 1 mln shares.

text.p: The Liposome Co Inc said that Ross Financial Corp, an investment company owned by Kenneth Dart has agreed to purchase one million shares of Liposome at $20.875 a share, its closing price on Tuesday.

Ross is buying its shares directly from Liposome. Dart is the president of Dart Container Corp. Liposome also said its board has given approval under its shareholder rights plan to permit purchases by Ross up to 25 percent of its common stock, without triggering provisions of its shareholder rights plan.
Under the plan, shareholders may not purchase in excess of 15 percent of Liposome's stock without board approval.
This additional purchase raises Dart's stake in Liposome to a 16.3 percent position.
Following the transaction, Liposome will have 37.2 million shares outstanding.
Liposome said that it plans to use the funds it receives toward its product development programs.
